paite: Huai khit in Galili gam ah Jesu avak a; Judate'n amah hihlup atup ziak un Judia gam apha nuam kei hi.
heading: Jesu Leh A-unaute

paite: Judate Biakbuk Ankuangluina anaita hi.
Huchi in a-unaute'n akiang ah, "Hiai a kipan in Judia gam ah va hoh in, na nungzuite'n na thilhih amuhtheihna ding un," achi uhi.
"Kuamah in aguk in thil bangmah ahih kei ua, amah mah in alangtang in mite theih ding in ahih hi. Hiai thilte na hih ngalleh khovel kiang ah kimusak in," achi uhi.
A-unaute nangawn in leng amah agingta kei uhi.
Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Ka hun atung nai kei; nou hun zaw chik lai peuh in atung gige hi.
Khovel in nou ahon ho thei kei, kei zaw hon ho nak uh, athilhihte uh gilou ahi chih ka theihsak ziak in.
Nou ankuangluina ah va hohtou unla, kei zaw tu ankuangluina ah ka hohtou tadih kei ding, ka hun atun nai louh ziak in," achi hi.
Huai thu akiang uah gen in Galili gam ah a-om nilouh hi.
Himahleh a-unaute ankuangluina a ahohtouh nung un, amah leng vantang theih louh in, aguk bang in ahohtou sam hi.
heading: Ankuangluina A Jesu Thuhilh

paite: Judate'n ankuangluina ah amah azong ua, "Koi a om ahia?" achi uhi.
Atung ah mipite lak a mi aphun sim supsup ua, khenkhat in, "Mihoih ahi," achi ua; khenkhat in, "Hi dek kei e, mipi khem ahi," achi uhi.
Himahleh Judate akihtak ziak un kuamah in alangtang in atungtang thu agenlang ngam kei uhi.
Ankuanglui san laitak in, tempul ah Jesu ahohtou a, thu ahilh hi.
Huan Judate'n, "Hiai mi'n zil ngeiloupi a bang achia hichi theih ahia?" achi ua, lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
Huan Jesu'n amau adawng a, "Ka thuhilh kei a hilou in, hon sawlpa thu ahi zaw.
Kuapeuh ama deihlam hih ut in ka thuhilh Pathian a kipan hia, keimah phuahtawm a ka gen chih athei ding hi.
Kuapeuh ama phuahtawm thu gen zaw, ama hoihna zong ahi; asawlpa hoihna zongmi mitak ahi, amah ah diklouhna himhim a-om kei hi.
Mosi in na kiang uah dan ahon pe kei a hia? Himahleh na lak uah kuamah in dan na zui kei uh. Nou bang achia hon hihlup tum na hi ua?" achi hi.
Mipi'n, "Dawi zawl na hi ve; kua'n ahia hon hihlup tum?" chi in adawng uhi.
Jesu'n adawng a akiang uah, "Thil khat ka hih nou tengteng in lamdang na sa uh.
Ahi a, Mosi in zeksum thu nou ahon piak ziak in Sabbath ni in leng mi zek na sum zel uhi. Huai pen Mosi a kipan hilou in pipute a kipan ahi zaw hi.
Mosi Dan a tatleklouhna ding a Sabbath ni a pasal in azek asum ngalleh, ke'n Sabbath ni a mi ka hihdam ziak in ka tung ah na heh tuam uh maw?
Akilatdan in ngaihtuah kei unla, diktattak in ngaihtuah zaw un," achi hi.
Huan Jerusalem a mi khenkhat in, "Hiai mi thah atuppa uh hilou hia?
heading: Khrist, Messia Hihna

paite: En dih uh, alangtang in hiai ah thu agen a, akiang ah bangmah agen kei uhi. Amah Khrist ahi chih vaihawmte'n thei taktak uh ahita diam?
Hiai mi ahong kipatna lam nangawn i thei ngal a. Khrist ahong kilat chiang in ahong kipatna lam kuamah in athei kei ding uh," achi uhi.

Huaiziak in tempul a Jesu'n thu ahilh kawm in akikou a, "Nou na hon thei ua, ka hong kipatna lam leng na thei uh. Himahleh keimah thu a hong pai ka hi kei, amah kei hon sawlpa midik ahi, amah lah na thei ngal kei ua.
Ke'n amah ka thei; amah a kipan a hong pawt ka hi a, ama'n lah ahon sawl ngal a," achi hi.
Huchi in amah mat atumta ua, himahleh ahun atun nai louh ziak in kuamah in akhoih thei kei uhi.
Mipi akhen tampite'n bel amah agingta ua, "Khrist ahong kilak chiang in, hiai mi hih sang in chiamtehna tamzaw ahih tuan dia hia?" achi uhi.
Huan Pharisaite'n atung a mipi phunna thute aza ua; huchi in siampu liante leh Pharisaite'n amah man ding in heutute asawlta uhi.
heading: Jesu Man Ding A Sawlna

paite: Jesu'n, "Sawt lou kal na kiang uah ka om phot ding a, hon sawlpa kiang ah ka pai ding hi.
Nou na hon zong ding ua, na hon mu kei ding uh; ka omna ah leng na hong thei kei ding uh," achi hi.
Huan Judate akihou ua, "I muh louh ding in hiai mi koi a hoh dek ahi ding? Grik pemdalhte kiang a hoh in Grikte thu va hilh ding adiam aw?
Nou na hon zong ding ua, na hon mu kei ding uh, ka omna ah leng na hong thei kei ding uh achih, bang achihna adiam maw?" achi uhi.
Huan ankuanglui ni nanungpen, ni thupi ni in, Jesu adingh a, akikou a, "Kuapeuh adangtakleh ka kiang ah hong henla, dawn hen.
heading: Tuihing Lui Jesu Ahi

paite: Kuapeuh kei hon gingta Laisiangthou gen bang in tuihing luite asung a pan ahong luangkhe ding," achi hi.
Hiai thu agingtate'n Kha atan ding thu uh agenna ahi; Jesu pahtawi a a-om nai louh ziak in Kha lah piak ahi nai tadih ngal kei ua.
Huchi in mipi lak a khenkhat in huai thu azak un, "Hiai zaw zawlnei hi petmah e," achi uhi.
Khenkhat in, hiai zaw, "Khrist ahi," achi ua, khenkhat in bel, "Bang ding in Galili gam ah Khrist ahong pawt tel dia?
Khrist zaw David suante lak ah, David omna khua Bethlehem a apawt ding ahi, chih Laisiangthou in agen kei a hia?" achi uhi.
Huchi in amah ziak in mipi akikhen ua, akilangta uhi.
Khenkhat in mat a-ut ua, himahleh kuamah in akhoih tuan kei uh.
Huan heutute, siampu liante leh Pharisaite kiang ah ahong pai nawn ua akiang uah, "Bang achia hon tonpih lou?" achi uhi.
heading: Juda Makaite Ginlouhna

paite: Heutute'n, "Hiai mi bang in kuamah in thu agen ngei kei," achi ua, adawng uhi.
Pharisaite'n akiang uah, "Nou leng pimang a om sam na hita uh maw?
Vaihawmte leh Pharisaite lak a mi amah gingta a-omta a hia?
Huai dan thei lou mipite sop lai, hamsethuak ei ve ua,” achi ua, adawng uhi.
Nikodem, tuma a Jesu kiang a hong, alak ua pang sam ahi a, ama'n akiang uah,
"Amah kam ngei a thu zak leh athilhih theih ahih ma, i dan un mi siam louh atangsak ngei a hia?" achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Nang leng huai Galili mi na hi sam maw? Zong lechin, Galili gam ah zawlnei kuamah pawt ding a-om kei uh chih thei tanla," achi ua, adawng uhi.
Huan michih ama inn chiat ah apaita uhi.
